Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Airbnb's gift cards empty state - after a loading beat, the title lands and two gift cards spring in from below, tilting into a casual stacked pose.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light modal screen: close button, Airbnb logo, "Airbnb gift cards" headline with subcopy, and an illustration zone where the gift cards land.

## Motion spec
Pattern: springy card slide-in, ~1s.
- The screen starts on a three-dot loading state (dots pulse in sequence, 300ms cycle).
- Title, subcopy, and logo fade up together (300ms, 20px rise).
- The photo gift card slides up from below the illustration zone (spring stiffness 240 damping 17), rotating from 0 to its resting -8deg tilt during the flight.
- A solid pink card follows 120ms later on the same motion, landing behind and offset at +6deg, so the pair reads as a fanned stack.
- Both cards settle with one visible overshoot bounce, then hold a barely-there sway (+-1deg, 3s).

## Calibration
- The cards must overshoot rotation and position together - desynced axes make the bounce feel mechanical.
- Resting tilts are small and opposite; matching tilts read as one card's shadow.

## Reduced motion
Cards fade in at their resting poses; no sway.

## Don't miss
- The pink card enters later but settles first - it has less travel; that ordering reads as physical stacking.
- The loading dots never overlap the title's entrance; the beats are sequential.
